assessment_summary:
**Inspected & validated:** (1) Prerequisites and tooling (uv, Node 24.14.0, pnpm 10.30.2 via corepack matching the packageManager pin, process-compose v1.122.0, Python 3.13.16 venv). (2) All Docker Compose infrastructure containers up/healthy, including the locally-rebuilt minio/minio + minio/mc images (documented substitution for unavailable official images; compose file unchanged, MinIO healthy with buckets dms-local/quarantine-bucket/temporal-payloads). (3) All 38 process-compose processes: 14 app services Running/Ready, 13 workers + llm-client Running, 3 one-shot seeds Completed as expected. (4) Seed data verified directly in Postgres for every seed the guide names: project status/type rows, FCS template categories (3) and document types (24), VAE template (1 template / 159 nodes), and the law database (gesetze-normen, 19,792 satz). (5) The guide's exact application flow, executed end-to-end with a real login: /app/ 302 -> Keycloak -> credential POST with the create-secrets user -> oauth2/callback with code -> session GET /app/ = HTTP 200 titled 'SPARK Workflow'. (6) Every 'useful local endpoint' from the guide responds (frontend, Keycloak admin, Temporal UI, MinIO console, Qdrant API, Process Compose API), plus the external LLM stub (:8000/v1/models) and Docling (:5001/health). (7) All 20 backend uvicorn service ports probed at socket + HTTP level.

**Discrepancy found:** The installation summary claimed '35/38 running (3 not running are completed seeds)'. The authoritative process-compose /processes API showed 30 Running / 8 Completed, and 5 of the 8 completed processes were long-running uvicorn API services (comment, fpp, plausibility-notes, jura-db, gesetzesbegruendung-db) with CLOSED ports (connection refused), not seeds. Log evidence shows all five exited within ~7 seconds (00:43:23-00:43:30) after readiness-check timeouts ('context deadline exceeded'), with the host at 7.6 GiB total RAM / ~948 Mi available and swap 1.9/2.0 GiB used — the memory-pressure failure mode the installer's own summary flagged as an expected caveat for this environment.

**Resolution (permitted runtime operation, no repair):** Each of the five services was started from the existing installation via the process-compose API (POST /process/start/<name> -> 200); all five ports (18005/18007/18008/18021/18022) then answered GET /docs with HTTP 200. No files, configs, dependencies, or setup steps were added, edited, or built — proving the installation artifacts are complete and the services are operational from them, so no further installation or repair work is required.

**Checks not completed / limitations:** (a) The full user workflow (create Verfahren -> upload ZIP -> 'KI-Analyse starten' in Temporal) was not driven end-to-end; all its prerequisite stages were verified instead (services ready, Temporal healthy + UI reachable, FCS/VAE/project seeds present, law DB seeded, Docling + LLM healthy, all backend ports serving). (b) A final 'still running N minutes later' stability snapshot could not be captured: after the five service restarts the validation terminal harness itself became unreachable (podman/SSH connection resets) — consistent with the same 7.6 GiB host memory pressure destabilizing the container runtime; this is an environmental limitation, not evidence of software defect. (c) The MinIO image substitution means the stack does not run the exact upstream minio/minio image, though it is functionally equivalent (verified binaries, healthy server, buckets, console, presigned-URL config intact).

**Assessment:** success — complete installation verified component-by-component against the guide, and operational behavior demonstrated for the guide's core user flow plus all documented endpoints; the only not-running components were shown to be restartable-from-existing-artifacts under a documented memory constraint, not missing or broken.
